ValueSet-who-identifier-types.title: ANC Identifier Types Schema
ValueSet-who-identifier-types.description: JSON Schema for ANC Identifier Types ValueSet codes. Values are represented as Coding objects with 'system' and 'code' properties.
ValueSet-who-identifier-types.narrative: This schema validates Coding-shaped objects for the ANC Identifier Types ValueSet. Each value must be an object with 'system' (CodeSystem URI) and 'code' (fragment after '#') properties. Display values are available at http://fhir.org/guides/who/core/ValueSet-who-identifier-types.displays.json. The canonical IRI for a code can be reconstructed as system + '#' + code. For a complete listing of all ValueSets, see artifacts.html#terminology-value-sets.
